description: This file defines the ProductAttributeDao interface, which declares data access methods for ProductAttribute entities, including retrieval based on options, values, products, and attribute IDs.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDao
classes.description: Data access interface for ProductAttribute entities, providing methods to retrieve attributes based on option IDs, option value IDs, products, and attribute IDs.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific option ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific option value ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific product within a merchant store, considering the language.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes matching the provided list of attribute IDs within a merchant store.
